claim.quote: After applying all event selection criteria, two events are observed, consistent with the expected background of 2.3±0.4 events.

date.note: arXiv v1 date; the collaboration's page lists the paper as Phys. Rev. D 113, 112011 (2026).

key_value_text.quote: however the expected number of events due to LSND anomaly is 1.1±0.5
key_value_text.value: 2 events observed against an expected background of 2.3 +- 0.4 events; 1.1 +- 0.5 events expected from the LSND anomaly (2022 data)

name: First results from the search for an excess of electron antineutrino events in JSNS2

official_url.quote: The first results on sterile neutrino search using 2022 data was published.

summary.plain: In its first direct test of the LSND anomaly, using 2022 data, JSNS2 saw two electron-antineutrino candidates where about two were expected from background. The LSND signal would have given about one extra event, so the test cannot yet confirm or rule it out.
summary.technical: 2022 data: two events after all selection cuts, consistent with 2.3 +- 0.4 expected background; expected number from the LSND anomaly 1.1 +- 0.5, so the result is stated as not yet conclusive. Data taking continues; JSNS2-II adds a 48 m detector.

title: First results from the search for an excess of electron antineutrino events in JSNS2
why_it_matters: The first result of a dedicated, independent re-test of the LSND short-baseline excess with the same oscillation channel, a different source and a Gd-loaded detector.
